Description:

Company

We take pride in solidifying all of our partnerships with integrity and respect. It’s not only the way we do business, but also what we believe in as a business.

The foundation of our colocation services model has been quite simple, provide quality always-on infrastructure and the most responsive support services available. 

Our focus is to deliver quality infrastructure, services and support, giving you the ability to allocate more resources toward your core business.

Below are the Services which we provide for all Data Centers in Sydney

1.	Cabling

Common tasks performed include cable termination and moving, securing or swapping existing cabling.

2.	Troubleshooting

Data Center Support technicians perform troubleshooting, verify device status or “heartbeat checks”, swap equipment, plug-in serial cables, work with you using team viewer and more.

3.	Access

Customer-authorized vendors and consultants can be escorted to and from colocation space – and monitored until completion. Data Center Support technicians also assist with access requests and lockouts.
 
4.	Media Management

Data Center Support will swap tapes, storage media or removable media as well as replace hard drives and burn CD’s.

5.	Storage & Material Management

Technicians will confirm package receipt, place or install shipped equipment in your colocation space – or store your packages in our loading unit.

6.	Rack & Stack

Tasks such as installing equipment, moving or discarding boxes or hardware – and cleaning of customer colocation space can be performed.

7.	Connectivity

Functions may range from circuit testing and diagnostics to circuit migrations, IP assignment, signal checks and cable swaps.

8.	Inventory & Auditing

Tasks may include full or partial space audits, labeling, photographing colocation space, tracing cross connects or verifying power consumption.

9.	Shipping & Receiving

Packing, labeling, unpacking and inventory of boxes and equipment can be performed at request.

10.	Contacting Our Technicians

 Visit our website www.datacentersupport.com.au and fill the form and someone will get in touch with you as soon as possible or email us at Support@datacentersupport.com.au

Our services include:
• Compliance & regulatory approvals management (GCF, PTCRB, CE, FCC, UKCA)
• Mobile network operator approvals (Pre-testing as well as formal operator testing)
• Live network testing (2G / 3G / 4G / 5G / VoLTE / VoWifi / NB-IoT / CAT-M1 / LTE. Cat 1 bis)
• Open Market device and MVNO solutions
• GCF Cellular Field Trials testing and certification
• e-SIM remote provisioning certification testing
• Mission critical and public safety comms testing against the 3GPP TS.11 Annex N Detailed Test Procedures
• Satellite Ground Station telecoms compliance testing
• Consultancy and support

If you have wireless testing requirements, don’t hesitate to get in touch via email at: information@iotas.co.uk or please contact the office on 01223 810018.

Name: ACN Pacific
Description:
The ACN story is 2 decades in the making! Today, ACN is the world’s largest direct seller of telecommunications and essential services, having serviced millions of satisfied customers on four continents.

ACN launched operations in January 1993 in Southfield, Michigan, as a long distance agent for a company by the name of LCI International, positioning ACN to take the lead as their consumer sales and marketing arm. LCI was later purchased by Qwest Communications for $4.4 billion, and ACN represented an astonishing one-third of LCI’s business.

ACN’s international expansion started in June 1997, when operations were extended into Canada. Today, ACN markets and provides service in 27 countries, with more countries planned for future expansion.

In July 2000, ACN decided to become a telecommunications company and introduced its very own long distance service: ACN Long Distance. This service set the standard for outstanding long distance service in North America and Canada.

Three years later, on the dawn of its 10-year anniversary, ACN exploded onto the local calling scene, providing customers with the freedom to choose their local phone service provider. Globally, ACN now offers a wide range of telecommunications and essential services including Home & Business Phone, Mobile, Broadband Internet, Digital Phone Services and video phones, Energy, Home Security and Satellite TV.

Today, ACN has offices located throughout North America, Europe, the Pacific and Asia. The company’s tradition of providing consumers with services they need and use every day continues still and is the reason why ACN leaders believe the company’s greatest growth lies ahead.

Name: Vertel
Description:

We specialise in the design, build and operation of mission and life critical telecommunications infrastructure and associated network services across Australia. We focus on delivering carrier grade communication networks across Australia in fringe metro, regional and remote locations.

We have pioneered the delivery of Ethernet and Broadband network services through the use of carrier grade microwave access technology in the ‘last mile’ to deliver critical networks even to regional and remote areas. We integrate this independent access network with our own and third party fibre backhaul to create a service that is 100% independent from other major carrier's networks.

As one of the few Australian carriers to achieve the MEF (Metro Ethernet Forum) CE 2.0 certification for our Carrier Ethernet services, we are uniquely positioned to address redundant and primary connectivity in fringe metro, regional and remote Australia. We are the world's first organisation to achieve MEF Carrier Ethernet certification for Microwave services.  

Combined with our private mobile network offerings and extensive data centre interconnects, we are fast becoming the provider of choice for organisations that place the highest of importance on network up-time and service utilisation.

We have offices across the country in Sydney, Coffs Harbour, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth and Adelaide, with a national Network Operations Center in NSW that proactively monitors our networks 24/7.

In order to do this, we build data centre facilities in sustainable regions where typically local demand is starved of enterprise capability due to physical distance from existing data centre services.   We call this problem “capital city syndrome”.    I.e. in Australia this is closely equated to locations or ‘medium’ population hubs that are at a distance from the major capital cities of Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth (where there is plenty of data centre capacity).   We have also progressed plans to develop  in SE Asia including India and Nepal.

In our mesh, each node may be a hyperscale facility in its own right, but it only evolves into that mature state based on the demand at that geographical location.   We offset development investment risk by only building capacity in a modular fashion when it is needed and by using a Turnkey solution.  This is a proven business model in other parts of the world.
 
Whilst our core offering is data centre services, as our solution is a community integrated offering, what exists inside the facility is also extended to the rest of the community where we offer both IOT solutions, Smart City Ring Infrastructure/Canopies and Backhaul connectivity.   ie we build beyond our four walls.  Where we can, what platforms we adopt in our facility, we offer to the wider community in a transactional consumption model allowing business that normally can’t afford the latest technology to consume as and when they may see the opportunity to differentiate.  We also seek to consume locally offered community services in preference to building or developing our own (As an example we do not build board rooms into the facility and generally push that to commercial buildings nearby).   

We are the solution where the market is currently weak.

Squidoo allows users with little or no technical background to create content rich webpages regarding any topic they wish. 

In essence, Squidoo is a network of user-generated lenses - single pages that highlight one person's point of view, recommendations, or expertise. Lenses can be about anything, such as ideas, people or places, hobbies and sports, pets or products, philosophy, and politics. Lenses aren't primarily intended to hold content; more emphasis is placed on recommending and then pointing to content on the web. 

Users who create lenses are called lensmasters. A lensmaster uses the tools available online to provide links, feeds, abstracts, and lists to users who are trying to make sense of a topic. For example, a single lens could point to Flickr photos, Google maps, blogs, eBay auctions, YouTube videos, and other links. Lensmasters are encouraged to promote personal agendas, expertise, causes, products, and opinions. Squidoo splits its revenue with its "co-op" of lensmasters: 5% goes straight to charity, first; then 50% goes to the lensmasters; lastly 45% goes to Squidoo.

Our acquisition of Titan ICT, rebranded to BAI Communications in May 2026, has strengthened our mission-critical capabilities, adding deep expertise in mining, resources, and energy industries. This expansion enables robust solutions across Australia’s most demanding operational environments. The combined organisation delivers end-to-end ICT services across the full asset lifecycle, from strategic advisory and independent assessment through to engineering design, systems integration, and 24/7 managed support.

BAI Communications is part of a global network alongside sister organisation Boldyn Networks, which operates across the Northern Hemisphere. This alliance is backed by majority shareholder CPP Investments and minority shareholder AIMCo, enabling us to leverage international expertise while maintaining focus on Australia’s unique connectivity needs.

Explore our capabilities through our virtual tour platform, BAI360 - https://bai360.baicommunications.com

Name: Blue Wireless
Description: Blue Wireless is a leading Global Provider of Wireless Solutions, offering LTE/5G Fixed Wireless Access and Managed Starlink connectivity for Global Enterprises. We deliver ultra-reliable and flexible connectivity solutions where traditional wired networks struggle - branches, retail stores, remote locations and the maritime sector. Our global experienced team leverages the latest Starlink and Cradlepoint technologies to service customers in over 100 countries worldwide.

Name: Aussie Broadband
Description:
Aussie Broadband is in business to change the telco game.

We're a rapidly growing internet service provider with a reputation for providing high-quality internet, transparent customer service and a great place to work. We are proud to have an all-Australian based support team, and don't need to go offshore. We believe it is possible to work smarter, not harder, and keep jobs locally.

We've evolved from a start-up in a lounge room in Morwell, later merging with Westvic Broadband, and now listed on the ASX.  We are the fifth largest provider of NBN services across Australia.

We offer a range of services across the residential, small business and enterprise segments, wholesale and white label segments. Aussie Broadband is also well-known for operating a quality network, with the rollout of our own fibre network across Australia underway. 

We not only challenge the game in telco, but also other games worth playing - like a focus on inclusion, values that live within the business rather than on the walls, how a rapidly growing company can still feel like a family, how we can make our communities better, and how a regional business can make a national impact.

Name: ShoreTel
Description:
ShoreTel is now part of Mitel. Together, we look forward to powering connections in the cloud that are brilliantly simple.

A global market leader in business communications powering more than two billion business connections, Mitel (Nasdaq:MITL) (TSX:MNW) helps businesses and service providers connect, collaborate and provide innovative services to their customers. Our innovation and communications experts serve more than 60 million business users in more than 100 countries.

Name: Kordia
Description:
Kordia is a leading provider of mission-critical technology solutions. Our expertise spans connectivity, infrastructure, cyber security, field services, media and broadcast; and safety of life services. 

Our team consists of almost 500 highly skilled consultants, cyber security analysts, field technicians, engineers; and sales and support staff - all of which are passionate about resolving problems and delivering smart solutions to our customers. 

We have a rich heritage in technology. For more than 65 years Kordia has been trusted to keep businesses connected. Kordia is also responsible for the network that monitors over 1/4 of the world’s oceans to ensure safety of life at sea. 

And, in an online world where cyber threats continue to rise at a rapid rate, Kordia is trusted to keep businesses safe online. We have the most comprehensive cyber security offering in New Zealand. Managed Cyber Security Services, a 24/7 Cyber Defence Operations, Managed Firewall, and expert advice from leading cyber-security consultants, Aura Information Security, are just some of the services we provide. 

Kordia is a state-owned enterprise. For more information visit: www.kordia.co.nz

Name: Myriota
Description:
Connect anything, anywhere. Global IoT solutions that “just work”.

Myriota was founded in 2015 to revolutionise IoT through simple, secure and affordable access to data using advanced, direct-to-satellite technology. Myriota IP covers all aspects of the end-to-end solution; edge, satellite and cloud.

Enabled by anywhere connectivity, a vibrant ecosystem of Myriota Partners including Solution Providers and Original Equipment Manufacturers are unlocking previously impossible or impractical use cases to deliver tangibly better outcomes across water, agriculture, defence, logistics, environmental monitoring and more.

From safeguarding critical resources to maximising operational efficiency, global organisations now have access to critical data, anywhere and everywhere it’s needed. For more information please visit: www.myriota.com

Name: OQ Technology
Description:
OQ Technology is a Luxembourg-based satellite operator pioneering standardized 5G Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) through its global Direct-to-Device (D2D) satellite network. As Europe's first company operating a LEO constellation dedicated to D2D services, OQ Technology leverages its Mobile Satellite Services (MSS) S-band spectrum rights to deliver secure, seamless, and standards-based connectivity directly to unmodified smartphones and IoT devices.

By bridging terrestrial and space-based mobile networks, OQ Technology enables 3GPP-compliant 5G NTN communications for governments, enterprises, and consumers worldwide, supporting applications across critical infrastructure, public safety, energy, logistics, maritime, agriculture, transportation, and defense.

Over the past years, OQ Technology has played a key role in advancing Europe's sovereign NTN ecosystem through strategic partnerships, commercial deployments, and support from leading European institutions, including the European Innovation Council (EIC), the European Investment Bank (EIB), and the European Space Agency (ESA).

Having successfully commercialized satellite NB-IoT services, the company is now expanding its next-generation D2D constellation to deliver emergency broadcast, two-way messaging, voice, and data connectivity on a global scale.

With headquarters in Luxembourg and offices across Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Australia, OQ Technology is building the next generation of global satellite connectivity.

Name: APWireless Infrastructure Partners, LLC
Description: APWireless is a leading global telecommunications and digital infrastructure investment company. APWireless specializes in the strategic acquisition and management of critical telecommunication infrastructure including cell site leases, network switches/exchanges, fiber aggregation points, Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS), data centers, and towers. With more than 13,800 lease streams spanning across 23 countries, APWireless is one of the largest international real property acquirers globally. APWireless is a subsidiary of Radius Global Infrastructure, Inc., a portfolio company of EQT Active Core Infrastructure SCSp and the Public Sector Pension Investment Board. More information about APWireless is available at https://www.apwip.com

Name: NSW Telco Authority
Description:
NSW Telco Authority operates and manages the Public Safety Network to deliver radio communications for frontline responders. 

We work with emergency services and telecommunications carriers to protect communications assets during emergencies and natural disasters. 

NSW Telco Authority is a delivery agency with responsibility for over $1.5 billion in key NSW Government projects that connect communities and support emergency services.  

We lead and coordinate whole-of-government connectivity strategy to bridge the digital divide and help keep people and places safe.

Name: Hexatronic
Description:
Connectivity creates opportunity. Hexatronic delivers future-ready fiber solutions for critical infrastructure, from telecom networks to harsh environments and data centers. Our systems are built to last, designed to scale, and supported by expert training and field services. In close collaboration with our customers, we shape solutions that strengthen communities and drive innovation in a connected world. 

Join us in building a connected future!

Name: Teletalk Bangladesh Limited
Description:
Teletalk Bangladesh Limited is a state owned public limited company, registered under the Registrar of the Joint stock companies of Bangladesh. Total shares owned by the Peoples Republic of Bangladesh.

We continue to grow and engage our customers through our clear commitment to offering high quality products and services as well as leading customer retention and loyalty programmers. Teletalk continues to be a part of the revolution that’s connecting millions of Bangladeshi people and around the world.

Teletalk Bangladesh limited was established keeping a specific role in mind. Name: iiNet
Description:
iiNet is an Australian Internet Service Provider and a leading challenger in the telecommunications market. We're committed to making it simple for all Australians to get online across both our own ADSL2+ network and the exciting new nbnTM technologies. 

Our vision is to lead the market with services that harness the potential of the Internet and then differentiate with award-winning customer service. We employ more than 2,500 enthusiastic staff across four countries - 80 per cent of whom are employed to directly service nearly one million customers.

iiNet has a proud history of delivering awesome customer service, which has won us dozens of awards, including a silver medal in Customer Service at the 2015 Contact Centre World Best Practice Conference (Asia-Pacific).

A lot has changed since iiNet was founded in a suburban garage in 1993 and the broadband landscape continues to evolve. What hasn't changed is our passion for the transformative benefits of the Internet and our commitment to helping Australians connect better.

Name: MATRIXX Software
Description: MATRIXX Software delivers a dynamic billing, monetization and charging solution proven at scale. Global service providers like Telefónica, IoT providers like Tata Communications and network-as-a-service providers like DISH rely on MATRIXX to overcome the limitations of existing billing applications. MATRIXX provides a unified platform that transforms and simplifies billing operations across consumer, enterprise and wholesale businesses. With MATRIXX, operators can rapidly configure, deploy and monetize personalized offerings, enabling commercial innovation and real-time customer experiences that drive revenue and growth.

Name: BSA Limited.
Description: BSA has evolved to become one of Australia’s leading technical services companies, providing rich and adapted solutions that are both flexible in delivery and a testament to many years of industry practice.

Name: Network Innovations
Description:
As technology solution integrators, we enable our customers to conduct some of the most important work on the planet – from the front office to the remote mission or field operation. Our customers depend on us for honest advice, a wide array of innovative offerings, and superior service to ensure their worlds are connected securely and seamlessly.

Meeting Your Mission. With Passion.

NI also maintains an extensive network of more than 200 partners operating globally throughout the Americas, Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Name: LinkQuest Technologies Limited
Description: At LinkQuest, we specialize in optimizing the efficiency and performance of telecom networks. Our mission is to maximize the potential of telecom infrastructures by providing cutting-edge optimization solutions that ensure seamless connectivity, superior performance, and cost-effective operations. LinkQuest operates in more than 22 countries including India, America, Middle East, ASEAN and Africa. Name: TXO
Description:
TXO is a global leader in transforming technology for a more sustainable future. We enable organisations worldwide to optimise and transform technology across its entire lifecycle, accelerating sustainability, unlocking value, and delivering measurable environmental impact.

Founded in 2005 as Transmission Only, TXO has evolved from enabling networks to stay connected into a global circular economy partner supporting sustainable technology transformation.

Our service offering combines product solutions with engineering expertise across field engineering, network services, spare parts management services (SPMS), test and repair, infrastructure rationalisation, asset recovery and urban mining, supported by complementary capabilities.

We integrate every stage of the technology lifecycle into a single circular, fully managed approach that helps organisations improve performance, extend asset life and achieve measurable environmental and operational outcomes.

Supporting customers in more than 140 countries, sustainability is the foundation of everything we do. Backed by TowerBrook Capital Partners’ impact strategy, TXO continues to expand globally while remaining committed to its circular economy principles.

Name: Icomera
Description:
For over two decades, Icomera has been the world’s leading provider of onboard connectivity solutions. We enable millions of passengers to connect every day with the fastest, most reliable and secure Internet connection currently available to a moving vehicle. 

Today our networks have the power to fully integrate tens of thousands of vehicles into the cloud, paving the way for a vibrant new world of smart, connected transportation. In the future, our network connectivity will empower a bold new generation of safer, more efficient and sustainable transport solutions. We aim to be the partner of choice for those on the smart, connected journey that lies ahead. 

A wholly owned subsidiary of Equans, Icomera is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, with key offices in the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, the United States and Canada.

Name: 5G Networks Ltd
Description:
5G Networks Pty Ltd (ASX:5GN) is a licenced telecommunications carrier operating across Australia. Technology leadership, people and exceptional customer experience; key foundations to our approach which enables customers to thrive in a digital world.

– Data Networks
– Cloud & Hosting
– Managed Services

Description: At Telstra Wholesale, we give you the network, solutions and industry expertise to help you succeed in the mobile, IoT and messaging markets. Because your brand deserves mobile solutions you’re proud to call your own.

Name: Tampnet
Description:
Tampnet owns and operates the world’s largest offshore high-capacity communications network. Serving customers across offshore and onshore energy, renewables, drilling and maritime industries, as well as the carrier sector, Tampnet delivers first-class telecommunications through a robust, flexible and resilient network. Our solutions ensure seamless, reliable connectivity that supports mission-critical operations and accelerates digital transformation where it matters most. 

With a portfolio spanning subsea fibre, 4G/5G and Private 5G, Tampnet provides reliable, high-speed, low-latency connectivity that enables safer, smarter and more sustainable operations – from site to shore – on more than 450 offshore and nearshore installations worldwide, with 5400 km of subsea fibre and 600.000 km2 of mobile coverage. With the development of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites, delivering high-speed, low-latency connectivity, Tampnet has also included LEO services from the leading providers, Starlink and OneWeb, into its portfolio. 

The company employs more than 170 people, is headquartered in Stavanger, Norway, and has additional offices in the UK, The Netherlands, USA, Brazil and Trinidad & Tobago.

Name: Exetel
Description:
Starting life over 15 years ago as a family-owned business, Exetel today is a part of the Superloop Group, Australia's fastest-growing challenger telco. 

Superloop has been listed on the ASX since 2015, and the company’s purpose is to shake up the market by enabling much better internet for Australian homes and businesses. 

Both of our challenger retail brands (Exetel & Superloop) are built on our next-generation Infrastructure-on-Demand platform. This platform allows us to deliver game-changing network and customer service experiences for residential, business and wholesale customers alike.

Name: LoopUp
Description:
What if you could dispense with the frustration, fragmentation and complexity of managing a disparate patchwork of regional telecoms vendors?

And just have one.

And just have one.

And just have one.

Name: COMMEND
Description:
At Commend we are passionate about innovating and perfecting trusted communication and reliable security technology. 

Our mission is to translate this passion into Intercom and Public Address solutions that you can always trust to support and protect your business, reputation, assets and even lives. 

For more than 50 years your voice, your needs and your trust has been our inspiration in all we do, from R&D and production, to customer consultation and installation as well as aftersales services. 

The result are trusted communication solutions that are built around your requirements to serve your business and safety needs – whether in road tunnels, on the factory floor or in the operating theatre, on ships, yachts or trains, and in places from car parks to office buildings and Smart Cities.

Name: KOINONIA ENTERPRISES

ATDI supplies radio network planning tools to manage every part of the network lifecycle from initial radio network planning to optimising coverage and reducing interference. Our software solutions support emerging technologies such as 5G network planning and other radio technologies. 

For spectrum management, we offer a flexible platform featuring powerful data engines with automated process-driven features and modules for the management of the radio spectrum. ATDI provides smart spectrum solutions for every radio technology.

We offer consultancy services to support every industry sector for both the civil and military markets.

At Techner, we deliver engineering services and managed workforce solutions across the Telecom, Infrastructure, Utilities, and Maritime sectors.

Name: Communications Day (CommsDay)
Description:
Communications Day Australasia is Australia and New Zealand’s most respected source of daily telecom industry news and commentary.

First published in 1994, it has published over 6500 issues and in that time has stacked up independent awards from the likes of the Australian Telecommunications Users Group, Service Providers Action Network (now Communications Alliance) and MediaConnect Australia. It is also regularly cited as a reference in government and industry reports.

CommsDay is published in the early hours of each working day in PDF format, sent by email to its subscriber base, which reads like a who’s who of Australian telecom industry executives. Daily readership exceeds 7,000 and surpasses 10,000 on big news days.

CommsDay is written by an experienced team of telecom-expert writers led by Grahame Lynch, Simon Dux and Rohan Pearce, and featuring regular commentary from Tony Chan and Dylan Bushell-Embling.

CommsDay is for you if:

- you need daily news and analysis about the Australasian telecom market
- you are an executive with an Australian/NZ telecom firm or an executive with Australian/NZ territory responsibility
- you want to keep in touch with your Australian/NZ competitors

Name: DTEN

The satellites are placed carefully in synchronized orbits that circle the earth almost every hour and half. The satellites communicate between each other and each satellite beams down to in a circular footprint. The constellation thus creates a mesh in the sky where each satellite serves as both as a base station and a router.

Name: LyreBird Network Ltd
Description:
Lyrebird is building something that has never existed before: a single, globally interoperable private 5G network operating entirely within licensed MNO spectrum, without site licensing, without regulatory fragmentation, and without borders.

The problem we solve is fundamental. Enterprises deploying private 5G today face a fractured landscape: spectrum available in one country but not another, no interoperability standards between jurisdictions, and MNOs structured for domestic markets rather than global enterprise. The result is inconsistent, insecure, and unscalable. We call it the current state of play and it's what we exist to replace.

Lyrebird’s platform is the world's first multinational MVNE/MVNO for private 5G. By operating our own PLMN and partnering with national MNOs through MOCN RAN sharing agreements, we deliver private 5G to enterprise campuses using the same licensed spectrum the MNO already holds simultaneously serving both networks from a single 5G cell, with full traffic separation and zero interference with public subscribers.

Our first market is Portugal, where we are anchoring an EU STEP-funded sovereign 5G manufacturing and deployment programme in partnership with ANACOM. Portugal is set to be the reference architecture for an EU-aligned global private network platform.

We serve logistics operators, manufacturers, ports, and critical national infrastructure. Our target customers are multinationals who need one private 5G contract that works everywhere they operate.
The private 5G market is growing at 40%+ CAGR toward $23B by 2030. Lyrebird is the only company positioned to capture it at a global, licensed, sovereign scale.

We are growing fast and hiring exceptional 5G engineers, network operators, and commercial leaders. If you want to build something that has never been built so join us.

Around that core sits everything a reseller needs to run the fleet: real-time telemetry and alerts, automated billing and invoicing, customer self-service portals, and bulk operations across thousands of kits.

Also in the platform: router fleet Wi-Fi management, remote dish diagnostics, prepaid licensing and vouchers, white-label branding, mobile apps for field teams, and an interface in four languages.

The CapTel phone is for people with some degree of hearing loss, the Captioned Telephone, or CapTel, works like any other telephone with one important addition: It displays every word the caller says throughout the conversation. CapTel phone users can listen to the caller, and can also read the written captions in the CapTel's bright display window. 

How does CapTel Work? 

CapTel phones work with a free captioning service provided by the Australian government to provide captions of everything your caller says. 

You dial the other person's number, exactly the same way as with any other telephone. While you dial, the CapTel phone automatically connects to the captioning service. When the other party answers, you hear everything they say, just like a traditional call. At the same time, the captioning service transcribes everything they say into captions, which appear on the bright CapTel display window. You hear what you can, and read what you need to.
